changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cmr_datasource ADD COLUMN connect_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unconnected' COMMENT 'unconnected/connected/failed' AFTER auth_config, ADD COLUMN required_ok TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '上游 4 项必填是否齐全', ADD COLUMN upstream_dataset_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '上游 dataset_id', ADD COLUMN vectorized_count INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '已完成向量化条目数', ADD COLUMN total_count INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '上游条目总数', ADD COLUMN last_sync_time DATETIME COMMENT '上次同步完成时间';

changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cmr_datasource_blacklist ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', dataset_id VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '上游数据集 ID', name VARCHAR(128) COMMENT '数据集名称', source_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '来源名（结果页按此匹配排除）', endpoint VARCHAR(512) COMMENT '数据源地址', create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F' COMMENT '逻辑删除', KEY idx_source_name (source_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 数据源黑名单';
